answer: The ridge counter is kept in crystal and reef reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 76 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
